verdict.rationale: LlamaParse docs show provenance features for specific extraction modes — pandas table extraction includes 'source-page provenance' (docs-15) and the forms JSON pass returns bounding boxes and field values (docs-22) — but this is not documented as a universal, per-field guarantee across all extraction outputs, and there's no explicit 'source snippet' citation mechanism shown. A 2024 community question ('Is there a way to return page numbers also with the markdown?') suggests this wasn't a default, ubiquitous feature at least historically. Missing for 10: documented per-field provenance (page+bbox+snippet) uniformly across LlamaExtract/Classify/Split outputs, not just tables/forms, and independent verification that markdown/JSON outputs always carry page numbers.
